cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women (20 who had a vaginal delivery and 20 who had a caesarean section).
finding: The study found that women who underwent caesarean section experienced a more significant and prolonged increase in platelet count (reactive thrombocytosis) compared to women who had a vaginal delivery, highlighting the importance of considering this difference in postpartum care.
mod_finding: Women who underwent caesarean section experienced a more significant and prolonged increase in platelet count compared to women who had a vaginal delivery.
